scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run test
scripts.pw:smoke: playwright test -c tests/visual/playwright.config.ts structural.spec.ts breakpoint.spec.ts resize.spec.ts mobile.spec.ts practice.spec.ts onboarding.spec.ts install.spec.ts
scripts.pw:smoke:hosted: playwright test -c tests/visual/playwright.hosted.config.ts structural.spec.ts breakpoint.spec.ts resize.spec.ts mobile.spec.ts practice.spec.ts onboarding.spec.ts install.spec.ts
scripts.smoke: npm run build:single && npm run pw:smoke
scripts.smoke:hosted: npm run build:hosted && npm run pw:smoke:hosted
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm run build && npm run pw:smoke && npm run pw:smoke:hosted
scripts.vr: npm run build:single && playwright test -c tests/visual/playwright.config.ts
scripts.vr:hosted: npm run build:hosted && playwright test -c tests/visual/playwright.hosted.config.ts
scripts.vr:update: npm run build:single && playwright test -c tests/visual/playwright.config.ts --update-snapshots
